data.gender_notes: Hamimun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ammiyah is the name of the mother of the believers, known for her unwavering faith and devotion to Allah and His Messenger. The name Hamimun carries the meaning “Ammiyah, mother of the believers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hamimun usually hope their child will grow to embody ammiyah, mother of the believers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of love, compassion, and unwavering faith.
data.etymology: Hamimun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ammiyah, mother of the believers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamimun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Hamimun
in_english.meaning: A beautiful name derived from 'ham' meaning warm, cozy and comfortable
in_english.long_meaning: Hamimun is a name derived from the Arabic root 'ham' meaning warm, cozy and comfortable. It is a name that conveys a sense of warmth, comfort and contentment. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the qualities of mercy, compassion and kindness. It is a name that is said to bring blessings and good fortune to the bearer. In Arabic, the name Hamimun is written as حَميمون and is pronounced as 'hah-EE-moon'. The name is popular in many Muslim cultures and is often given to children born in the spring season, symbolizing new life and renewal. The name Hamimun is also associated with the Arabic word for 'summer' and is often used to describe someone who is warm and affectionate.
